publication.title: Curriculum-Augmented GFlowNets for mRNA Design: Enhancing Sequence Generation

observed_dependency_recovery.published_torchgfn_failure: ImportError: cannot import name MLP from torchgfn.src.gfn.utils.modules
observed_dependency_recovery.selection_reason: First installed public release line tested that provides the MLP API imported by unmodified CAGFN source; v1.1.1 and v1.2 do not provide it.
observed_dependency_recovery.claim_boundary: Dependency compatibility recovery, not the exact published environment and not an official author-endorsed correction.

bounded_run.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 WANDB_MODE=offline python main.py --config_path config.yaml --arch MLP --n_iterations 2 --n_samples 20 --batch_size 16 --hidden_dim 256 --n_hidden 4 --embedding_dim 32 --seed 42 --run_name bounded_smoke

required_outputs: independent sequence translation, GC, CAI and MFE verification

claim_boundaries.cross_method_mfe_reason: CAGFN uses its bundled RNAFolder; LinearDesign comparisons use ViennaRNA-based frozen scorers.
claim_boundaries.figure_interpretation: The supplied paper figures show a protein-legal codon DAG and internal metric distributions/training time. They do not provide same-hardware LinearDesign or EnsembleDesign comparisons, paired confidence intervals, or functional evidence. Conditional-versus-unconditional similarity in a histogram is not an ablation or a significance test.

independent_zero_policy: Never accept an MFE or CAI value of exactly zero as valid without a separate successful fold/CAI computation; upstream utility functions convert exceptions to zero.

wrapper_recovery.root_cause: The wrapper resolved the venv python symlink to the base interpreter before subprocess launch.
wrapper_recovery.only_change: Preserve the absolute venv python path without Path.resolve().
